title: Good, but room for improvement
text: I've subscribed for about 3 months.  The designs (so far) have been good, but I would prefer to be able to choose the color of the shirt.  I wear these pretty much daily, and after a few months, the shirts are showing signs of wear.  If there was "premium shirt" option, I would certainly pay more for the shirt.  Per another reviewer's suggestion, I have purchased some MCRN and OPA shirts elsewhere that are higher quality.  I may cancel this subscription once I evaluate the quality of the other shirts.  I like the concept here, but I would suggest at least having an option for a premium quality shirt.
label: neutral
